parameters.content:
INTEGRATION DRAFT, NOT A READY BACKEND. All data is synthetic.
Missing before it can run:
1) backend_base_url (HTTPS origin) in "Integration config"
2) n8n Credential "UzWealth backend API" (Simplified Custom Auth, not yet created) on both HTTP nodes: no secrets in Code/JSON/URL
3) event_id: business-event UUID (empty by default; invalid UUID gives CONFIG_REQUIRED before any HTTP). Its lowercase form is used directly as the Idempotency-Key, without a prefix; stored per business event and reused on every retry, never generated per execution.
Polling: GET only on the same origin, redirects disabled (credentials never leave the origin), 5s interval, one 45s deadline created in Validate that covers POST and waits; stale requests are not sent and late responses are not published. After timeout retry POST only with the SAME key.
Do not run until the backend exists.

n8n is only the orchestration wrapper (integration shell). The production CORE is a separate Python FastAPI/LangGraph backend; this workflow does not replace it and is not the backend. It is a DRAFT: backend URL and auth are not configured yet.
4 business nodes: extract_profile, get_market_data, quant_allocation, generate_report.
Storage: PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB + Redis; immutable market snapshot; timestamps/freshness.
Telegram initData is validated on FastAPI. Disclaimer is static, added by code.

Crypto default OFF; provider from a verified registry (UzNEX not hardcoded).
External LLM OFF until data processing is agreed; user DB located in Uzbekistan.

nodeGroups.name: Prepare request
nodeGroups.description: Manual start; checks HTTPS backend URL and builds the idempotent request. Stops with CONFIG_REQUIRED.

nodeGroups.name: Create job
nodeGroups.description: POSTs the synthetic profile with a stable Idempotency-Key and reads job_id from the 202 reply.

nodeGroups.name: Poll job
nodeGroups.description: Checks the shared 45s deadline before each GET, polls the same origin every 5s and classifies the job status.
